answer: Random beacon audits with a compute heartbeat block cheap sybil farms. Each epoch the beacon picks random identities; each must solve a small puzzle and prove a live workload. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 puzzles on time, about 1,000 cores, while an honest agent solves one puzzle on one core. Honest agents pay one short check per epoch; each pass builds the kernel of trust keeping rewards undiluted and lifts them toward the summit.
